reuse.why: Reuses recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule and the shared getDateWithSkippedWeekend (which already encodes the daily-skip rule), but re-inlines the skipWeekend ternary instead of extracting a shared occurrence-adjustment helper with getUpcomingDates.

duplication.why: The RSchedule construction, the `config.skipWeekend ? getDateWithSkippedWeekend(...) : date` mapping, the null filter and the captureBreadcrumb try/catch are copied from getUpcomingDates.

placement.why: The handler sits next to getUpcomingDates in server/schedules/app.ts and is registered in the same handler map, as the tree does for schedule handlers.

scope.why: Only the new handler, its import, its registration and tests.

maintainability.why: Clear and commented (MAX_WEEKEND_SHIFT_DAYS), but the weekend adjustment wrapper now lives in two handlers that must be kept in sync.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses getDateWithSkippedWeekend and recurConfigToRSchedule rather than going around them.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied skipWeekend ternary and try/catch from getUpcomingDates are verbatim in getDatesInRange (packages/loot-core/src/server/schedules/app.ts), only the map chain is written as a loop; it is an overt copy rather than a disguised one.
